pages.title: Happy New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Rounded Happy New Year lettering fills this printable coloring page in three rows between a ribbon and scattered stars. The wide letters and open ribbon loops provide large areas to color.

pages.title: New Year 2027 Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children peek over the outlined digits 2027 in this printable coloring page, with one waving and the other raising a fist. A cone hat, a large hair bow, and curling streamers frame the numbers.

pages.title: New Year Countdown Clock Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling countdown clock raises its gloved fists in this printable coloring page, with both hands pointing up at midnight. Twin bells and rounded shoes give the clock a character shape between curling streamers.

pages.title: New Year Ball Drop Coloring Page
pages.description: A faceted New Year ball sits on a tall tower in this printable coloring page, above a stepped skyline and beneath drifting confetti. Diagonal struts echo the triangular panels across the ball.

pages.title: New Year Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children in scarves watch fireworks in this printable coloring page, raising their hands below three large bursts and a row of city buildings. The curved firework trails spread across the upper half of the scene.

pages.title: New Year Firework Rocket Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling firework rocket rises diagonally in this printable coloring page, with a pointed cap, striped body, and a trail above a cloud. Smaller bursts and diamond-shaped sparks surround the rocket.

pages.title: New Year Sparklers Coloring Page
pages.description: Two crossed sparklers fill this printable coloring page, with rounded handles below jagged bursts and small stars around the tips. Long shafts lead the eye from the bottom corners toward the sparks.

pages.title: New Year Party Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A cone-shaped New Year party hat fills this printable coloring page, with a scalloped pom-pom, curved bands, and three outlined stars. A short ribbon curls below the wide brim.

pages.title: New Year Party Horn Coloring Page
pages.description: A curled New Year party horn stretches diagonally across this printable coloring page, with a short mouthpiece, broad stripes, and floating confetti. The spiral end shows how the paper rolls back on itself.

pages.title: New Year Party Popper Coloring Page
pages.description: A New Year party popper sends streamers flying in this printable coloring page, with a tilted tube decorated with stars and diagonal bands. Circles and diamonds fill the spaces between the curling ribbons.

pages.title: New Year Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Three round balloons and two star balloons rise from a bow in this printable coloring page, with small shine marks inside their outlines. The strings gather at the bottom beneath the wide balloon shapes.

pages.title: New Year Balloon Drop Coloring Page
pages.description: Balloons tumble from an overhead net in this printable coloring page, with curved motion marks and streamers beside the falling shapes. A roped railing and floorboards define the party space below.

pages.title: New Year Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: A hanging disco ball takes up most of this printable coloring page, with curved grid lines separating mirror panels and four diamond-shaped sparkles around it. The panels narrow toward the edges of the sphere.

pages.title: New Year Champagne Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Two champagne glasses touch at their rims in this printable coloring page, with round bubbles rising above the stems and curled ribbons nearby. The matching glass shapes balance the composition on either side.

pages.title: New Year Masquerade Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: A feathered masquerade mask spans this printable coloring page, with pointed eye openings, a central star, and a slender handle on one side. Curved bands and sweeping feather edges divide the mask into separate sections.

pages.title: New Year Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: A sparkler tops the swirl of frosting in this printable coloring page, above a cupcake decorated with stars and round sprinkles. Vertical wrapper folds contrast with the curved layers of icing.

pages.title: New Year Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A two-tier New Year cake fills this printable coloring page, with a clock topper, star decorations, and scalloped frosting on both tiers. A pedestal stand supports the cake beneath a row of rounded icing beads.

pages.title: New Year Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A clock, a party hat, and a star appear as decorated cookies in this printable coloring page, arranged on a round plate. Double icing outlines separate the designs from their baked edges.

pages.title: January 1 Calendar Coloring Page
pages.description: A January 1 calendar fills this printable coloring page, with a large outlined numeral beneath the month and two rings at the top. Stars and short accent marks decorate the date panel.

pages.title: New Year Resolutions Coloring Page
pages.description: A child writes New Year resolutions in this printable coloring page, with an open notebook, a pencil, and an alarm clock on the desk. Fireworks appear through the window behind the seated figure.

pages.title: Baby New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby New Year sits with open hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped party hat, a diagonal sash, and a diaper. Both feet face forward beneath the curved edges of the sash.

pages.title: Father Time Coloring Page
pages.description: Father Time holds an hourglass in this printable coloring page, with long hair, a flowing beard, and wide robe sleeves framing his hands. The folds of the robe extend down toward two visible shoes.

pages.title: New Year Hourglass Coloring Page
pages.description: An upright hourglass fills this printable coloring page, with rounded pillars, outlined sand grains, and stars around its wooden-style frame. The narrow center separates the two chambers and the falling grains.

pages.title: New Year Family Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: A family raises glasses around a New Year table in this printable coloring page, with party hats, a small cake, and fireworks through the window. A plate of fruit sits beside the cake.

pages.title: New Year Kids Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children celebrate in this printable coloring page, with one blowing a curled party horn and the other holding a balloon by its string. Their patterned hats stand out beneath the loose streamers.

pages.title: New Year Dance Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Two dancers raise their hands beneath a disco ball in this printable coloring page, with bent knees, festive hats, and streamers overhead. The dress folds and the bow tie add details to their silhouettes.

pages.title: New Year Bells Coloring Page
pages.description: Two New Year bells hang beneath a ribbon bow in this printable coloring page, with round clappers and stars around the flared rims. A curled streamer falls between the bells near the bottom.

pages.title: New Year Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: A midnight clock sits inside a New Year snow globe in this printable coloring page, with fireworks, round flecks, and snowbanks around its base. The broad stand gives the globe two open bands to color.

pages.title: New Year Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A midnight clock centers this printable coloring page, surrounded by rings of bells, balloons, stars, and ribbons in a circular mandala. The repeating motifs fit inside a complete outer border.

pages.title: New Year Greeting Card Coloring Page
pages.description: A folded New Year greeting card stands upright in this printable coloring page, with a midnight clock, three firework bursts, and ribbons on its cover. The back panel peeks above the front edge.

pages.title: New Year Dinosaur Coloring Page
pages.description: A dinosaur blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a spotted cone hat above its rounded snout and short forearms. A curved tail and large clawed feet complete the standing figure.

pages.title: New Year Big Ben Coloring Page
pages.description: Big Ben rises between two firework bursts in this printable coloring page, with pointed windows, visible clock faces, and a tall spire. Lower rooflines and shrubs sit beneath the tower.

pages.title: New Year Eiffel Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Fireworks flank the Eiffel Tower in this printable coloring page, showing its tapering frame, cross-braced levels, and wide arch at the base. Small diamond-shaped sparks sit between the larger bursts.

pages.title: New Year Sydney Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: Fireworks burst above the Sydney Opera House in this printable coloring page, with the Harbour Bridge behind the sail-shaped roofs and ripples below. The broad roof panels contrast with the bridge's smaller braces.

pages.title: New Year Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: A snowman blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped hat and scarf beside falling confetti and curling ribbons. One twig arm supports the horn while the other reaches outward.

pages.title: New Year Penguin Coloring Page
pages.description: A penguin spreads its flippers in this printable coloring page, with a striped party hat, a bow tie, and stars around its rounded body. The belly and wide feet form separate areas to color.

pages.title: New Year Polar Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated polar bear holds a sparkler in this printable coloring page, with a cone hat, bow tie, and outlined pads on its hind paws. Small stars surround the bear's raised forepaw.

pages.title: New Year Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A teddy bear holds a star-shaped balloon in this printable coloring page, with stitched seams on its belly and paws beneath a party hat. The balloon string curves past its raised paw.

pages.title: New Year Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny blows a curled party horn in this printable coloring page, standing on wide hind paws with long ears and a striped hat. A small tail peeks out beside its body.

pages.title: New Year Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat sits in a star-patterned party hat in this printable coloring page, with a broad bow, four visible paws, and a curling tail. Streamers and confetti leave open space around the cat.

pages.title: New Year Dog Coloring Page
pages.description: A dog sits beneath a pointed party hat in this printable coloring page, with floppy ears, a wagging tail, and a wide streamer across its chest. The ribbon trails along the floor beside its paws.

pages.title: New Year Unicorn Coloring Page
pages.description: A unicorn stands beside a midnight clock in this printable coloring page, with a striped horn, flowing mane, and spotted party hat. Small fireworks sit above the head and the four hooves are visible below.

pages.title: Hello Kitty New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty holds a star balloon in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped party hat, her familiar ear bow, and a scalloped dress. A waist bow and streamers fill smaller areas around the figure.

pages.title: Snoopy New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Snoopy lifts one foot as he blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped hat beneath two firework bursts. His raised paws meet near the front of his chest.

pages.title: Minecraft New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: A blocky Minecraft character raises a firework rocket in this printable coloring page, with squared shoes, stepped scenery, and three bursts overhead. Straight edges separate the arms, legs, and shirt into open shapes.

pages.title: SpongeBob New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob waves while holding a party horn in this printable coloring page, with a striped hat, square trousers, and loose confetti around him. The curled horn extends past his cheek above his bent arm.
